description.value:
Duration constant

Deadeye-flavored, open to all — precision damage against your Mark applies at any range.

Precision damage you deal to your Marked quarry applies at any range, ignoring the usual limit that confines it to closer distances. Range increment penalties to the attack roll itself still apply as normal.

cinderfall.incomplete: Otherwise a clean, single-clause rule (removing precision damage's normal range gate) — fully blocked on the Mark predicate. (P5 additionally shows real pf2e leaves range/cover-limit removal vs hunted prey unencoded even when unblocked, reinforcing the call.). The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
